name: Avel Sorn
description: She/her; custodian of the fellowship shared manuscripts, authorised to receive returned loans and settle recovery fees.
narrative: LOOKS:grey-haired woman in a plain wool coat, reading lenses on a cord. CORE:shared learning depends on keeping promises to one another. NATURE:dry humour, patient with people, direct about responsibilities. WOUND:too many colleagues mistake good intentions for permission. WANTS:receive the manuscript and hear Nimras account before judging Rennic. PRESSURE:asks plain questions; does not turn a report into a tribunal. KEY:warm welcome, dry familiarity with Rennic, short direct questions.

extras.role: Manuscript custodian; no leadership over all fellowship members or spellcasting capabilities implied.

score.secret: No hidden connection to Midnight Exchange or demonology
